weather_report:
As the night hangs in the cool embrace of downtown San Francisco, the air carries a clarity that promises respite from the day’s hustle. A gentle hush blankets the city, with the temperature nestling around a mild 56 degrees, where the west-southwest wind whispers softly through the streets at a leisurely pace. There is an unassuming beauty in this quiet hour, as the city prepares to wake to a sunlit morning.

By Sunday, expect a transition into warmth, as a sun-drenched day unfolds with highs near 65. The gentle caress of the southwest winds, dancing between 6 and 14 mph, will lend a playful touch as the afternoon cools slightly to 62. The morning sky will be an expanse of vibrant blue, inviting residents and visitors alike to step outdoors. The marine layer, a defining characteristic of the San Francisco area, may linger at bay but likely will not encroach. This makes for a day glorying in sunshine—a canvas for those who wish to explore. 

When dressing for this unseasonably pleasant day, aim for layers that can be donned or shed, embracing the cool morning air and warm afternoon sun alike. A light sweater paired with comfortable footwear will serve those who wish to wander along waterfront paths, pop into local cafés, or simply bask in the rhythms of city life. This is a day for small joys—a stroll down to the Embarcadero or perhaps indulging in a leisurely brunch at a favorite neighborhood haunt, as the city's charm unfolds amidst the warmth of a burgeoning autumn sun.
